page.layout: Page number 284 at the top left. One narrow column of italic and roman marginal summaries on the right of the scan, with the left side blank. No running head, catchword or signature in this part.; One column of text, cut off at the right edge. At the top a heading line "Fasti Co..." over a rule. Below it three numeral lines (I, I, Ii), then groups of names separated by rules. No margins, no notes, no page number, running head, catchword or signature visible.; One table: a left column of names and a right column of years, 1424 to 1431, with rules between the blocks. Above the table is a running title. Below the last line is one word at the right.
page.notes: The first summary line is preceded by a dash-like mark and a few specks, which are stains. Where the scan is faint I have marked uncertain letters. "in-fert" in the second summary is read with [?]. The ‡ marks are printed ornaments and are kept. The summary column is narrow and italic, so it is treated as a column of text, not as margin notes. Left-hand names are cut off at the left edge, so most entries are fragments. "obeldinge." and "aurissinge." are uncertain. A ")" stands beside the line "r." in the 1431 block, where it is a bracket or mark, not a letter. The daggers † and ‡ are reference marks in the year column and stand with their year. The word at the foot, "Lulof", may be cut off and is uncertain.
